answer: To register, newcomers wander through a challenge round where peers cross-attest and a random quorum replays their tasks. Each agent must stake a unique ivory ledger relic whose serial is bound to a verified hardware root and a prior epoch's signed work history. Duplicate identities fail because cloning one relic invalidates its serial, burning the stake. Attackers must acquire and maintain many distinct relics with real provenance, making each sock-puppet cost full stake plus ongoing work, so mass forgery becomes economically prohibitive.
